name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Calendar selection display fix after V0.62 confirmed that double-tap recognition, coordinates and internal date selection all succeed. Replace the subtle two-line border blink with an unmistakable 0.5 s selected-cell inversion (white cell with black date, then normal cell), restore the requested 400 ms calendar double-tap window, and remove first-touch diagnostic buzzing. Successful selection now gives one short 80 ms buzz.
